answer: Newcomers enter through a sponsor posting a 200 POA bond, with reputation fading like saffron in sunlight, down 10% per epoch without honest work. Cheating slashes the bond, so sponsors vet, not sell seats. Reputation, like an opal, grows layer by layer. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 sponsors and 20,000 POA, each fake decaying toward zero; the honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward. Fourteen epochs build it, like a sonnet's lines.
